description: Above brings your identity-security data into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language to list open incidents and high-risk identities; inspect incident timelines, evidence, and insights; look up devices, monitored applications, and audit logs; and run investigative searches across your tenant. You can also triage from chat — set incident status, verdict, and resolution notes, or add an identity to the watch list. Access requires an Above Security account and is scoped to your role and company; read and write are governed by explicit OAuth consent.

defaultPrompt: Show me my company's high-risk identities and the open incidents from this week.
Investigate john.doe@company.com — pull their identity overview, recent activity, risk score, and any linked incidents.
What monitored applications and browser extensions are in use, and flag anything risky.
